metadata.title: Broadcom Inc. stock outperforms competitors despite losses on the day - MarketWatch

content.text:
Company Close Updates
Broadcom Inc. stock outperforms competitors despite losses on the day
Shares of Broadcom Inc. AVGO tumbled 12.19% to $304.41 Friday, on what proved to be an all-around grim trading session for the stock market, with the S&P 500 Index SPX falling 3.70% to 6,910.39 and Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA falling 1.93% to 48,147.33.
This was the stock's second consecutive day of losses.
